highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 improves platform support and hardens the Windows native binaries.
highlights_body: It adds missing tvOS surface overloads, preserves Android symbols, and enables modern Windows exploit mitigations.

bullets.detail: Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS applications.
Android native symbols are retained to improve diagnostics for deployed applications.
Native DLLs enable Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks.

contributor_summaries.Aguilex: Hardened the Windows native DLLs with Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks
contributor_summaries.MartinZikmund: Added the missing tvOS SKSurface.Create overloads

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 introduced tvOS surface creation overloads and Android symbol preservation.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 hardened the Windows native binaries with modern mitigation options.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 finalized the native binary mitigation work before the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the HarfBuzzSharp native-package hardening alongside the Windows binary mitigations.
